fresh_evaluation_prompts: A paper airplane glided gently over the empty playground.
Describe how a telescope gathers light from distant galaxies.
A bakery opened before dawn to prepare fresh bread for the town.
Why should software engineers test programs under unexpected inputs?
The museum's new exhibit explains how ancient maps were drawn.
Explain one difference between photosynthesis and cellular respiration.
A careful traveler packed water and a raincoat for the mountain trail.
How do simple machines make lifting heavy objects easier?
The neighborhood garden grows beans, tomatoes, and fragrant herbs.
Give a brief explanation of why numerical experiments need independent replication.

method.source_only_quality: For each native original BF16 linear module i, compare actual local projection output error E||X(W-Q_b(W))^T||^2 relative to original output E||XW^T||^2 over fixed calibration inputs, b=4 vs b=8. This uses empirical off-diagonal input correlations, unlike diagonal E[x_j^2] weights. Does NOT perturb downstream tensors or final-logit output.
method.compute: Original BF16 model on Alienware CUDA, register non-mutating forward hooks, native original BEGLIN Q4G64 and qNg64 n8 encoders on CPU, FP16 resident perturbation matrices with FP32 CUDA local output dot products, explicit BF16 reference.
method.concurrency: One GPU forward at a time; quantization tasks may be bounded at 3 CPU workers only if memory permits; no concurrent GPU jobs. Apple CPU independent QKV/GU stage cost already separately measured, only enable parallel full model if native failclosed speed gate passes.
method.optimizer: Frozen 196 source-only tensor score vector; same measured native Q4/8 kernel costs and per-stage concurrent DAG. Exactly 28 n8, 168 q4, <=830570496 logical packed bytes, <=100ms serial estimated, <=50ms isolated async stage cost if feasible. HiGHS binary MILP optimum required. Policy frozen BEFORE evaluation.
method.evaluation: Use ONLY the 10 fresh public prompt strings above with exactly the same token IDs and native Qwen chat template in all policies; compare PPL/NLL and same-prompt full-model timing where practical.
method.promotion: Research only; do not promote if v3 candidate does not outperform all Q4 and role-balanced random quality tradeoff under same resource limits.
